quantity.description: Quantity to reserve. Must be a positive integer.

demandRef.description: Caller-supplied reference identifying the demand this reservation satisfies (e.g. an order id).

lineNo.description: Optional order line this reservation is for (ADR 0036). When sent it is stored on the reservation and returned as `lineNo`, and it lets the TaskCompleted consumer confirm exactly the picked line instead of counting picks (ADR 0035). Omit it, or send null, when unknown. Valid range is 1 to 2147483647 (a 32-bit integer); 0, negative values and values above 2147483647 are rejected with 400 `invalid-line-no`. Because it is part of the request body, adding it to a request whose Idempotency-Key was first used WITHOUT it is a different body (422 `idempotency-key-reused`).
